outcome: incidence of large/small for gestational age (LGA/SGA)
finding: When combined with an inadequate pre-pregnant BMI, excessive gestational weight gain acts as a 'synergic risk factor' for a poor outcome.
mod_finding: While the study found no difference in prevalence of cesarean section between normal and excessive weight gain groups, it did highlight that optimal gestational weight gain in women with obesity or GDM can lead to better pregnancy outcomes.
